name: PrintStash
description: PrintStash is a self-hosted 3D print library and G-code vault. This image runs the web UI and API together. Create the first account in the browser from your local network, or set First-run setup to environment and fill in the administrator fields to create it at first start. The one appdata path stores everything PrintStash keeps: the database, uploaded files, thumbnails, staging files, backups, and caches. Add existing model folders as separate Library sources after setup; do not use an existing library as the appdata path.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Dedicated persistent folder for everything PrintStash keeps: database, managed files, thumbnails, staging, backups, and caches. Keep it on one pool and add no second mapping for a subfolder of /data; imports then copy each file instead of using a hard-link. Do not map an existing model library here.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port to open PrintStash in your browser.

variables.name: First-run setup
variables.description: How the first administrator is created. trusted_network: in the browser, only from your local network (for example http://tower.local:3000 or the server's LAN IP); leave the administrator fields blank. environment: at first start from the administrator fields below, which are then required; choose this if you will first open PrintStash through Tailscale, a VPN, a reverse proxy or Unraid Connect.

variables.name: Administrator username
variables.description: Only with First-run setup set to environment: creates this administrator at first start; sign in with it and choose where files are stored. Leave blank with trusted_network, which creates the first administrator in the browser from your local network instead. Used once: it never changes an existing account.

variables.name: Administrator password
variables.description: Only with First-run setup set to environment: 8 to 256 characters. Used once: editing it later does not change the account; reset it under Settings, Users instead.

variables.name: Administrator email
variables.description: Optional, only with First-run setup set to environment: email for that administrator.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: Numeric owner for appdata and mounted Library sources. Default is Unraid's nobody user. On upgrade, use the old API data owner's UID to keep existing Library sources readable.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: Numeric group for appdata and mounted Library sources. Default is Unraid's users group. On upgrade, use the old API data owner's GID to keep existing Library sources readable.

variables.name: Settings restart
variables.description: Allows Settings to restart the supervised application container.
